screenshots.title: What you'll actually use.
screenshots.description: Real screens from the app — from the home screen to a finished PDF.

items.title: Your home base
items.body: Scan, import photos, or make a folder. Recent work is right there when you come back.

items.title: Point and scan
items.body: See the page outline while you aim. Hold steady and Scanly can capture for you — or use the shutter.

items.title: Fix the page
items.body: Crop, pick a filter, and tweak brightness or contrast until the page looks right.

items.title: Many pages, one document
items.body: Check every page, add more, and long-press to reorder before you export.

items.title: Find it later
items.body: Folders, documents, and search — so last week's receipt isn't lost in a camera roll.

items.title: Handy extras
items.body: QR codes and offline PDF tools sit next to scanning when you need them.

items.title: Export your way
items.body: Password, page numbers, paper size — set it, then generate the PDF.

features.title: The tools you need, nothing you don't.
features.description: Everyday scanning for receipts, forms, notes, and homework — kept simple and private.

items.title: Live edges and auto-capture
items.body: See the page as you aim. Auto-capture when it's steady, or take the shot yourself.

items.title: Camera or gallery
items.body: Scan live or import photos you already have. Same editing tools either way.

items.title: Filters that help
items.body: Try Auto, shadow reduction, color, grayscale, and more — they stay connected to the page you captured.

items.title: Edit without worry
items.body: Your original photo stays safe. Crop and filters can always be redone.

items.title: Documents and folders
items.body: Stack pages into one file, put work in folders, and jump back from Home.

items.title: Export and share
items.body: PDFs, image ZIPs, merged collections — share through the apps you already use.

development.title: Filters that look like your page.
development.description: Document filters now stay connected to the photo you captured, with consistent strength from picker to saved JPEG.

items.title: Connected color looks
items.body: Color, Shadow Reduce, and Magic clean the page without turning it into a different processed image.

items.title: Strength that fits the page
items.body: Already-good photos stay gentle. Dim or shadowed pages get more cleanup. Glare is no longer over-processed.

items.title: Scan modes stay readable
items.body: Clean, Grayscale, Text Enhance, B&W, and Receipt still produce a scan look without blowing out or going weak.

items.title: What you pick is what you save
items.body: Filter chips, the live editor preview, and the exported JPEG share the same analysis and look.

items.title: Same presets
items.body: The ten familiar filter names and Adjust sliders are unchanged — only the engine behind them is new.

items.title: Offline by design
items.body: Filter processing stays on the device. Existing documents and .scanly backups remain supported.

stats.label: where it runs
stats.note: Scanning and editing don't need the internet or a cloud account.

stats.label: where files live
stats.note: Your library stays on the device until you export or share.

stats.label: how you share
stats.note: PDFs, image ZIPs, and normal Android share sheets.

stats.label: the license
stats.note: Full source on GitHub if you want to build or contribute.
